panels.is: Cartoon dire wolves (oversized, manic, shaggy, flat house style with ONE outline round each animal and a soft shadow under it), side-on on a strip of dirt: standing; three moments of a walk wearing a yellow hard hat and an orange hi-vis vest with two silver bands, lightly bloodied; two moments of a run; a leap through the air; landing. Feet on the ground must stay planted, every leg joined to the body, the hat and vest sitting on the animal and bending with it.

The same wolves: feeding with the head down into a kill on the ground (the head the right way up, front legs braced) and ripping a hunk of raw meat up, the hunk held in its jaws; sitting (rump on the ground, front legs straight, tail lying on the ground) in a white hard hat and torn hi-vis vest, then looking back over its shoulder; pawing the dirt (one forepaw raking, grooves in the dirt); lunging with jaws open; recoiling when struck by a bar (eyes squeezed shut, ears flat, yelping); skidding to a stop with forelegs braced and dust thrown up. Blood: two reds with a small wet shine, stains on muzzles, chest ruffs, paws and vests, no bones or insides.

A wolf running straight at the camera in a hard hat and vest; a wolf leaping at the camera, forelegs flung wide, jaws at full gape; props on the dirt: a hard hat knocked off (one bloodied, one upright), a torn scrap of hi-vis, drops of blood in the air and landed drops soaking into the dirt, a dust puff; a walking wolf in an orange hard hat and yellow vest with no blood.
